14.4.title: DBS Reflector Antenna Directivity Calculation
14.4.title_cn: DBS反射面天线方向性系数计算
14.4.description: A DBS reflector antenna operating at 12.4 GHz has a diameter of 18 inches. If the aperture efficiency is 65%, find the directivity.
14.4.description_cn: 一个工作频率为 12.4 GHz 的 DBS 反射面天线，其直径为 18 英寸。若口径效率为 65%，求该天线的方向性系数。

steps.title: Wavelength Calculation
steps.explanation: Using speed of light $c=3\times10^8\text{ m/s}$ and given frequency
steps.explanation_cn: 使用光速 $c=3\times10^8\text{ m/s}$ 及给定频率计算波长

steps.title: Directivity Formula for Circular Aperture
steps.explanation: Standard directivity expression for aperture antennas
steps.explanation_cn: 口径天线标准方向性表达式

steps.title: Compute $\frac{\pi d}{\lambda}$
steps.explanation: Substitute diameter in meters and wavelength
steps.explanation_cn: 代入以米为单位的直径和波长

steps.title: Compute Directivity (Dimensionless)
steps.title_cn: 计算方向性系数（无量纲）
steps.explanation: Square the intermediate result and multiply by efficiency
steps.explanation_cn: 将中间结果平方后乘以效率

steps.title: Convert Directivity to Decibels
steps.title_cn: 方向性系数转换为 dB
